name: Hako no Naka no Jouji
source:
Kenichi is just a white-collar worker. One day, when he is on the internet, he finds an interesting blog about her erotic experiences in the train. He gets interested in her and sends her an email. Several days later, he receives a reply from her and they decide to meet in the train....

[From ErogeShop]
